Title: Event Hubs Premium now available in public preview

Body.Content:
Event Hubs Premium provides you with a multi-tenant offering with resource isolation, enabling more predictable high-throughput and low latency workloads while providing higher limits and extending support to more Apache Kafka workloads.

Learn more.
